table_and_index_ddl:
CREATE TABLE students (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	student_number VARCHAR(50), 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_students_org_student_number_live ON students (lower(replace(organization_id, '-', '')), student_number) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE students (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	organization_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	student_number VARCHAR(50), 
	deleted_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_students_org_student_number_live ON students (organization_id, student_number) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
